categories.main_business_segments: Horizon Robotics operates primarily in two segments: Automotive solutions and Non-Automotive solutions. The Automotive solutions segment includes product solutions and license and services related to advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous driving (AD) technologies. Non-Automotive solutions represent a smaller portion of the business.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company develops proprietary software and hardware technologies, including processing hardware such as the Horizon Journey series (notably Journey 6), and advanced algorithms for ADAS and AD. Their technology integrates vehicle intelligent computing architectures, with certifications in automotive safety standards like ISO 26262 and ASPICE. Production involves mass manufacturing of processing hardware and scalable IP licensing combined with one-stop development services.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Horizon Robotics serves automotive OEMs, tier-one suppliers, and electric vehicle manufacturers, primarily targeting passenger vehicles. Their customers include leading Chinese OEMs, global automotive giants, and top-tier EV brands. The company’s solutions are adopted for over 310 car models, with a strong focus on the Chinese market and expanding global partnerships.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and non-current assets are primarily located in mainland China, with principal offices in Beijing and Shanghai. It also maintains a principal place of business in Hong Kong and is incorporated in the Cayman Islands. Its market reach includes China as the dominant market with growing global partnerships.
categories.supply_chain_position: Horizon Robotics operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the automotive supply chain, providing core processing hardware, software algorithms, and development services to OEMs and tier-one suppliers. It licenses intellectual property and delivers integrated ADAS and autonomous driving solutions rather than manufacturing complete vehicles.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on advancing integrated hardware-software solutions for scalable ADAS and AD, emphasizing energy efficiency, safety, and user experience. Key R&D initiatives include the development of the Horizon Journey 6 processing hardware and the Horizon SuperDrive (HSD) full-scenario AD solution. Horizon Robotics invests heavily in R&D to enhance autonomous driving capabilities, safety certifications, and developer ecosystems.
categories.revenue_model: Horizon Robotics generates revenue through product sales of processing hardware and licensing fees for its software and intellectual property. It also earns from providing technical services and development support to OEMs and tier-one suppliers. The revenue mix is predominantly from automotive solutions, with license and services contributing the majority share.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading ADAS and AD solutions provider in China, holding over 40% market share in the Chinese OEM ADAS market and ranking second among independent third-party AD solution providers. It competes with global automotive technology firms and tier-one suppliers, leveraging proprietary technology and strategic partnerships to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Horizon Robotics reported revenue of RMB 2.38 billion in 2024, a 53.6% increase year-on-year, with gross profit rising 68.3% to RMB 1.84 billion. Despite operating losses, the company achieved a net profit of RMB 2.35 billion in 2024 due to fair value gains on financial liabilities. The company has grown rapidly since 2021, expanding delivery volumes to approximately 2.9 million units in 2024 and securing over 100 new design wins that year.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Horizon Robotics differentiates itself through its integrated hardware-software platform that delivers scalable, high-performance ADAS and autonomous driving solutions with human-like driving behavior. Its proprietary processing hardware (Journey series) and advanced algorithms enable efficient, safe, and user-friendly intelligent driving experiences. The company emphasizes high safety standards, energy efficiency, and a developer-friendly ecosystem to accelerate adoption and innovation.
